details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:20382-20451 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new comment at line 20382 ("# sandboxed poller_claude_judge WAVE_JUDGE run (no retries, no host fallback;") and the new `poller_claude_judge WAVE_JUDGE "${prd_prompt}" "${prd_out}" ...` call at line 20451 both match the regex at tests/test_orchestrator_judges_claude_engine.py:693, so the count goes from 6 to 8 while the assertion expects `len(SITES) + 3` = 6.
  WHY: CI shard "orchestrate-poll (3)" fails on head 9dec4ae with `assert 8 == (3 + 3)` (run 41391581164, job 125103935640), which blocks the merge and the stable gate; all reviewers rated it BLOCKER.
- scripts/persist_orchestrator.py:1205-1206 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `_REVISE_METADATA_LINE_RE` only detects metadata lines (`Integration branch:`, etc.) that sit at the very start of a title or body, so putting text such as "Note: " in front of one bypasses the forgery check.
  WHY: The reviewer says the first-match readers in `scripts/orchestrate_lib.py` could then parse and trust the injected metadata (anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash checked this and rejected it, because those readers use the same line-start anchoring).
- scripts/persist_orchestrator.py:1240 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The mention-neutralisation regex `item[key] = re.sub(r"@(?=[A-Za-z0-9_-])", "@\u2060", item[key])` also inserts U+2060 into text that is not a mention, such as email addresses or `@dataclass`.
  WHY: Invisible U+2060 characters could cause SyntaxErrors if the title or body text is later used as code or in CLI commands.
- scripts/persist_orchestrator.py:1265-1267 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The same regex `r"@(?=[A-Za-z0-9_-])"` does not check what comes before the `@`, so emails become `user@\u2060example.com` and decorators become `@\u2060pytest.fixture`. (This is the same code line as the 1240 entry; the cited line numbers are more than 5 lines apart, so the two were not merged.)
  WHY: If the implement agent copies such text into source, the result is a SyntaxError or broken code, and test_revise_validate_neutralises_model_written_mentions only covers `@user`. Three other reviewers raised the same issue as a hardening suggestion only.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:20451-20458 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new `poller_claude_judge WAVE_JUDGE` call site is not registered in the SITES contract in tests/test_orchestrator_judges_claude_engine.py (lines 672-690), so its sandbox-without-host-fallback checks (count == 1, no rc-75 branch within 700 chars) never run for it.
  WHY: A future host fallback added at this call would not be caught by CI; severity is disputed (gemini MAJOR, glm NIT, "No current failure"), and the highest was used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:20437-20439 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The temp-file cleanup `rm -f ${prd_reason:+"${prd_reason}"} ... ${prd_details:+"${prd_details}"}` relies on `:+` expansion to guard against empty strings.
  WHY: The reviewer says a set variable after a failed or partial temp-file creation could lead to wrong deletions or leftover temp files (anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected this, because `prd_details` is reset to "" on every failure path).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:32777-32797 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The log token `PERSIST redecompose outcome=skipped reason=current_wave_changed` is emitted on the in_progress branch where the poller stays on the current wave.
  WHY: The name suggests the wave advanced, which misleads operators grepping logs; the token is documented in agents.d and the prompt, so a rename must change both.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Plan P10 step 2 (docs/plans/persistent-unattended-workflows-plan.md:547): "when enabled and `revise_remaining` is true and `redecompose_count < PERSIST_ORCH_MAX_REDECOMPOSE`, run `prompts/mode-orchestrate-revise.txt`".
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, wave-judge output handling (in_progress arm, stay-on-current-wave branch, about lines 32771-32786)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The branch at lines 32771-32786 (about 32777-32784) only logs `PERSIST redecompose outcome=skipped reason=current_wave_changed`, and `persist_orch_redecompose` runs only in the `else` branch at lines 32789-32793, so an enabled, under-cap request is dropped whenever the same verdict adds current-wave new_issues; the judge prompt tells the judge to ask again later, a restriction the P10 plan does not have. Sonnet rated this NIT (delayed, not lost; earlier editor declined it), gemini and luna rated it MAJOR, and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash dropped it as an earlier won't-fix (CONSOLIDATOR_OVERRIDDEN).
- requirement: Issue #8644 acceptance criteria: "The P10 deliverables and tests listed in the plan are implemented and pass." The PR's pre-push gate lists `ruff` and `shellcheck` under "Failures caused by this change".
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (persist_orch_revise_option_block / persist_orch_redecompose) and scripts/persist_orchestrator.py (revise-input / revise-validate commands)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The gate classifies ruff and shellcheck failures as caused by this change, but no diff hunk addresses lint findings, and editor summaries saying ruff output is the same before and after contradict the gate. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected this because they could not map any concrete violation to a line on head 9dec4ae.
- requirement: "Pair workflow/script changes with the contract tests the plan calls for."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_persist_orchestrator.py
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The reviewer says test coverage of the full re-decomposition lifecycle is not enough, citing repeated CI timeouts and failures in `orchestrate-poll` and `orchestrate_poll_promote_cycle`. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected this, saying all three done-when fixtures already have tests.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (with tests/test_orchestrator_judges_claude_engine.py:693):20382, 20451 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: test_each_judge_uses_sandbox_without_host_fallback expects `len(SITES) + 3` = 6 matches but finds 8 (lines 8434, 10983, 20382, 20451, 20815, 30148, 30151, 32298); the matches at 20382 (comment) and 20451 (new call) are new in this PR, which the PR body wrongly calls "inherited".
  WHY: CI shard "orchestrate-poll (3)" fails on head 9dec4ae with "assert 8 == (3 + 3)" (run 41391581164, job 125103935640). Suggested fix: reword the 20382 comment, add a separate P10 assertion (exact count 1, no rc-75 fallback within 700 chars), and raise the expected total to len(SITES) + 4.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Plan P10 step 2 (docs/plans/persistent-unattended-workflows-plan.md:547): "when enabled and `revise_remaining` is true and `redecompose_count < PERSIST_ORCH_MAX_REDECOMPOSE`, run `prompts/mode-orchestrate-revise.txt`".
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, in_progress arm of the wave judge, stay-on-current-wave branch (about lines 32777-32784).
  Evidence of absence: That branch only logs `PERSIST redecompose outcome=skipped reason=current_wave_changed`, and persist_orch_redecompose runs only in `else`. The PR documents this as a conservative choice, so the request is delayed rather than lost, and the earlier editor declined it.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- (hardening suggestion) scripts/persist_orchestrator.py: validate_revise_output, `item[key] = re.sub(r"@(?=[A-Za-z0-9_-])", "@\u2060", item[key])`
  PROBLEM: Inserts U+2060 into emails and decorators. The substitution also runs before the `_is_bounded_str(..., REVISE_TITLE_MAX)` check, so a valid 255-256 character title that contains `@` is rejected as `schema`.
  WHY: Suggested fix: add the lookbehind `(?<![A-Za-z0-9_.\x60])`, optionally run the length checks first, and add an email test case. About 1-3 lines.
- (hardening suggestion) tests/test_orchestrator_judges_claude_engine.py: test_each_judge_uses_sandbox_without_host_fallback (line 685 onward)
  PROBLEM: The new revise call site has no count-1 or no-`-eq 75`-within-700-chars check.
  WHY: Suggested fix: assert that `text.count('poller_claude_judge WAVE_JUDGE "${prd_prompt}" "${prd_out}"') == 1` and add the window check. About 3 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/persist_orchestrator.py:1205-1206 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_REVISE_METADATA_LINE_RE` only detects metadata lines (`Integration branch:`, etc.) at the very start of a title or body.
  WHY: Putting benign text (e.g. "Note: ") in front of the line bypasses the forgery check, and the first-match readers in `scripts/orchestrate_lib.py` then trust the injected metadata.

  WHY: The invisible U+2060 can cause SyntaxErrors if the text is later used as code or in CLI commands.

  PROBLEM: The new call site and its comment inflate the regex match count used by `tests/test_orchestrator_judges_claude_engine.py` (line 693).
  WHY: CI job `orchestrate-poll (3)` fails on head 9dec4ae with 8 matches against an expected 6, which blocks the merge.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:20437-20439 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The cleanup `rm -f ${prd_reason:+"${prd_reason}"} ... ${prd_details:+"${prd_details}"}` relies on `+` expansion.
  WHY: If a variable is still set after a failed or partial creation, the cleanup could delete the wrong files or leave temp files behind.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:32777-32797 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `PERSIST redecompose outcome=skipped reason=current_wave_changed` is emitted where the wave does not advance.
  WHY: It misleads operators grepping for the token.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:20451-20458 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new `poller_claude_judge WAVE_JUDGE` call site is not registered in SITES in `tests/test_orchestrator_judges_claude_engine.py`.
  WHY: The sandbox-without-host-fallback check does not cover it, so a future host-fallback path would not be caught.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: P10: "when enabled and `revise_remaining` is true and `redecompose_count < PERSIST_ORCH_MAX_REDECOMPOSE`, run" the re-decomposition.
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, wave judge output handling.
  Evidence of absence: `persist_orch_redecompose` runs only in the `else` branch. When the verdict adds current-wave issues, the in_progress branch logs `reason=current_wave_changed` and skips the run, even when the switch is on; the plan does not allow this restriction.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
